title: Introduce invocation mosaic and cost lifecycle tracing
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: Production SREs and product engineers need a compact way to inspect invocation-level cost flows across the inference pipeline without being overwhelmed by raw span volume. This PR introduces an "invocation mosaic" summarizer and a small cost-lifecycle tracing pipeline that attributes per-invocation token cost across model stages (prefetch/prefix, decoding, KV-access, post-processing) and surfaces lifecycle metrics to dashboards and alerts.

What changed (high level): added a new sampler/compaction stage (mosaic_sampler) that coalesces fine-grained spans for the same invocation into a structured mosaic event; implemented a cost_lifecycle_aggregator that computes stage-level token costs and time shares; instrumented runtime to emit compact lifecycle traces and served a new invocation-mosaic dashboard for SREs and platform owners.

Files and components touched: mosaic sampler (Go), cost aggregator (Python batch job), dashboard JSON, lightweight integration tests, docs and Helm values.

Key behaviors and design notes: mosaic_sampler performs a deterministic merge of temporally adjacent spans that share invocation_id and route fingerprint, preserving boundary markers for KV/cache hits and model switching. The cost_lifecycle_aggregator consumes compact traces, attributes token cost using kernel-weighted heuristics and hardware tags, and writes rollups to the telemetry index with tags: invocation_id, tenant_id, model_version, stage, token_bucket. Traces remain linkable to full span stores via short-hash anchor.

Rollout and testing: feature gated behind runtime flag "invocation_mosaic_enabled". Canary rollout plan: 5% of traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 6 hours with health checks. Integration tests exercise mosaic compaction edge cases (out-of-order spans, late arrivals) and cost aggregation units. Local QA: run ./scripts/run_mosaic_sim.sh with sample traces; run integration suite tests/integration/test_mosaic_sampler.py.

Backward compatibility and performance: Mosaic events are additive (telemetry consumers can opt-in). Sampler uses bounded in-memory windowing and circuit-breaker to avoid amplification under high concurrency. Expected additional CPU <2% on control-plane services and small indexing cost; estimated incremental storage ~0.6% due to compaction.

Alerting and dashboards: new invocation-mosaic dashboard (dashboards/invocation-mosaic.json) with per-tenant cost lifecycle sparkline, stage latency waterfall, and mosaic-cohort heatmap. Alert tuning guidance included in docs/observability/invocation-mosaic.md (suggested SLOs and noise-suppression thresholds).

Checklist: [x] Unit tests added for sampler and aggregator [x] Integration tests added [x] Dashboard and runbook updated [x] Feature flag and gradual rollout plan included [x] Docs updated with examples and troubleshooting notes.

Related work: complements ENG-4213 (token-level attribution) and OBS-88 (alert calibration). This PR intentionally focuses on compact traces for interactive debugging and cost-exploration; follow-ups will add aggregated cohort queries and export adapters.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice compact design. Two asks: 1) add a circuit-breaker metric exposed to Prometheus so we can monitor sampler backpressure; 2) clarify how late spans are attached to mosaics in the writeup.

Priya Shah: Added sampler_circuit_breaker_total and expanded docs section on late-arrival handling. The aggregator now attaches a short-hash anchor and emits 'mosaic_late_attach' counter when late spans are reconciled.
Dmitri Ivanov: Integration test uncovered an ordering flake when the aggregator received out-of-order KV events. Requesting a deterministic sort and a test asserting stable anchors.
Priya Shah: Deterministic merge implemented (timestamp + sequence id) and new test added. Re-ran integration tests, no flakes observed locally.
Marina Lopez: Approved after verifying dashboard renders and CI green. Left a minor comment about wording in runbook which I will follow up on post-merge.
Marina Lopez: Merged via squash on 2024-11-12.

release_notes: Add invocation mosaic tracing and cost lifecycle rollups: compact traces for per-invocation cost attribution, new dashboard for lifecycle exploration, feature-flagged rollout. Improves SRE debugging and reduces trace volume for long-tail investigations.
testing_instructions: Canary rollout: enable feature flag on test cluster and use ./scripts/run_mosaic_sim.sh to drive synthetic invocations. Validate dashboard panels show stage breakdowns and ensure 'mosaic_late_attach' counters are near zero after warmup. Run tests: pytest tests/integration/test_mosaic_sampler.py && go test ./observability/tracing -run MosaicSampler
rollout_plan: Step 1: enable at 5% traffic for 1 hour with health checks (error rate, p50 latency). Step 2: 25% for 2 hours. Step 3: 100% if no regressions. Disable knob if circuit-breaker > 0.5% for 10m or index error rate spikes.
notes_for_operators: Feature flagged. Monitor sampler_circuit_breaker_total, mosaic_compaction_rate, mosaic_late_attach. Use short-hash anchor to query full spans in trace store for RCA. Index retention policy unchanged; compact traces are lightweight. If heatmap exhibits high cardinality, reduce cohort window via helm values.
